messages:
Claire: quick thread

quick thread - consolidating ideas for a 'lease-hint playbook'. want to capture modes, audit requirements, and operational knobs before RFC.
Devon: +1. Outline: modes (inline vs sideload), settlement semantics (hint-only vs authoritative), audit reconstruction, retention, and rollout.
Ibrahim: for hint-only mode, finalizer must produce deterministic settled attribution. propose deterministic tie-break order: (score, source_precedence, latest_ts).
Sofia: score = provenance_weight + freshness_bonus - penalty(duplicates). provenance_weight from hints: cache_hit > prefix > rerank.
Claire: storage: raw sideload tail 72h, checkpoints daily retained 1y. reconciler rebuild = checkpoints + raw tail. document exact offsets in checkpoint.
Devon: operational knobs: per-tenant join_window (ms), claim_retention_days, checkpoint_interval_minutes. defaults: 500ms, 3d, 15m.
Ibrahim: testing: dry-run reconciler, compare settled vs current ledger for canaries; chaos tests for out-of-order, duplicates, late arrivals.
Sofia: add debug API fields: initial_hint, settled_attribution, settled_reason, timeline_url. invoices use settled_attribution.
Claire: security: salt fingerprints per-tenant, no PII in claim messages.
ops-bot: uploaded draft: https://go/repo/lease-hint-playbook (comments open) :eyes:
Devon: i'll review PR checklist: schemas, scoring pseudo, checkpoint format, rollout steps. will add test matrix. :thumbsup:
